answer: Quadratic weighting plus a non-transferable identity deposit blunts Sybil farms. Each verified agent holds one soulbound key and posts a refundable deposit; influence grows as the square root of its vouches, so ten fake keys earn far less than one trusted key. An attacker splitting one reputation into a swarm must fund a fresh deposit per head for only diminishing returns. Audits trace shared funding to the juniper root, and a flagged cluster sees its whole plume of linked deposits burned. An honest agent risks one deposit; a sparrow army pays per puppet yet loses sway.
